def mainWorkflow(trigger_input: [{...}]):
  """
  comments: Main workflow to process commercial entries from Google Sheets, classify descriptions with AI, and send results to Slack
  TODOs: 
    - Test end-to-end workflow
  """
  # Step 1: Read commercial entries from Google Sheets
  sheet_data = action_0(trigger_input)

  # Step 2: Calculate loss and prepare AI input
  ai_input = []
  for item in sheet_data:
      json_data = item["json"]
      cost = float(json_data.get("cost", 0))
      sales = float(json_data.get("sales", 0))
      loss = cost - sales
      description = json_data.get("Description", "")
      # Build messages array for AI
      messages = [
          {"role": "system", "content": "You are a news classifier. Classify as 'to Business' or 'to Customer'."},
          {"role": "user", "content": description}
      ]
      ai_input.append({"json": {"messages": messages, "loss": loss, "Description": description}})

  # Step 3: Call AI classification
  ai_output = action_1(ai_input)

  # Step 4: Parse AI output and prepare Slack messages
  slack_input = []
  for i, item in enumerate(ai_output, start=1):
      ai_text = item["json"]["choices"][0]["text"].strip()
      # Extract category from AI text
      category = "to Business" if "to Business" in ai_text else "to Customer" if "to Customer" in ai_text else "Unknown"

      # Get corresponding original Description and loss
      description = ai_input[i-1]["json"]["Description"]
      loss = ai_input[i-1]["json"]["loss"]

      message_text = f"[{i}]. Commercial Entry: {description}\n loss: {loss}\n Category: {category}"
      slack_input.append({"json": {"text": message_text}})

  # Step 5: Send messages to Slack
  slack_output = action_2(slack_input)

  return slack_output
